method: SHA-256 and mode comparisons of selected existing configuration/credential/identity/certificate/policy files; read-only SQLite logical identity, membership, enrollment, channel, token and budget table hashes; process PID/start identity. Private contents and individual hashes are not exported.
scopeLimits: Selected local files/tables/processes only; not a claim about unobserved installations or WSL identities.
Runtime session logs, caches, source/venvs and mutable database journals are excluded; selected SQLite logical rows are compared instead of whole database bytes.
Supplemental application/export and live-service identity baselines were captured after private test work started; those paths were not test targets.
Private raw exports and credentials were only hashed for preservation; no credential values were imported into test configuration or Git.
